title: Lesser Scaffolding
description: allows scaffolding to be crafted with sticks, but at half the yield
body:
allows scaffolding to be crafted with sticks instead of bamboo, but at half the yield.

i made this because i hate having to walk aimlessly until i stumble upon a bamboo jungle, but also didn't want to make crafting with bamboo completely useless.

(image for illustrative purposes only)
